jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Fullstack Analyst Developer with solid front-end expertise, particularly with React and .NET, to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be able to contribute to the design, development and maintenance of software applications used by our customers.

Working with an experienced team, he/she will actively participate in the continuous improvement of our processes and software architecture.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• Analysis and Design: Analyze functional and technical requirements and design appropriate software architectures.
 
• Fullstack development: Develop and maintain complex web applications, with particular emphasis on the frontend using React and TypeScript, while ensuring seamless integration with backend APIs in .NET.
 
• Performance Improvement: Optimize the performance and user experience of front-end applications to ensure smooth, responsive use.
 
• Testing and Quality: Participate in technical and quality testing phases to ensure the reliability of developed functionalities.
 
• Support and Maintenance: Collaborate with teams to maintain existing modules and adapt IT solutions to specific customer needs.
 
• Continuous Improvement: Contribute actively to the improvement of internal processes and development practices, in particular through code reviews.
 

Your profile

• Education and experience: Significant experience in software development and databases.
 
• Technical skills:
 
• Expertise in React, TypeScript, and React ecosystem tools (Redux, React Router).
 
• Good knowledge of .NET backend development and relational databases (SQL Server appreciated).
 
• Proficiency in versioning tools (Git) and CI/CD processes.
 
• Good command of Microsoft Office suite and .NET Framework (VB.NET, ASP.NET, C#).
 
• Analytical and Communication Skills: Analytical mind and ability to solve complex problems, with attention to detail and respect for delivery deadlines. Excellent communication skills in French, with good knowledge of English.
 
• 
Personal qualities: Ability to work effectively in a team, adapt quickly in an Agile environment and develop a positive working attitude with technical teams, colleagues and customers.

Your day-to-day tasks will include aligning IT systems and coming up with projects. You’re seen as a mentor for your team who’s always training and coaching to hit milestones and get things done. You can communicate these ambitions with cross-departmental partners, stakeholders and management alike, making organisation-wide collaboration possible. Proven experience with Drupal 8/9/10 is essential, along with strong knowledge of PHP and MySQL. Familiarity with modern development tools and best practices for web development is a plus.

About the Role:

As an Information Security Officer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization's IT infrastructure and sensitive data. Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and implementing robust security protocols and procedures
• Conducting regular security assessments and audits
• Monitoring and responding to security incidents
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures
• Serving as a point of contact for security-related inquiries
• Leading the certification project for ISO27001
• Staying updated on the latest cybersecurity trends and best practices

Qualifications and Skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
• Fluency in Dutch, with strong English language skills
• Proven experience as an Information Security Officer or similar role
• In-depth knowledge of security frameworks, standards, and best practices (e.g., NIST, CIS)
• Strong understanding of network security, encryption protocols, and secure coding practices

Personal Qualities:

• Accountable and transparent
• Tech-savvy and passionate about IT
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to work autonomously and deliver high-quality results

Introduction
For one of our fastest growing practices we are looking for a Data Quality Assurance Specialist. 

Do you have 3 to 5 years of experience of which at least 2 to 3 years in the field of data analysis and/or data quality? And the prospect of helping to grow a company that believes in together creating an impact with Data at our customers sounds good? 

Then we are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 
Your responsibilities
• Support clients in the execution of activities of the data quality cycle: data analysis, data quality assessment, impact assessment, etc. Allowing them to independently monitor, prevent and remediate emerging critical data quality issues.
• Evaluate data from data sources to identify and interpret trends. Identify data quality issues, determine business impact, find out the root cause, collaborate to resolve, and make recommendations for long-term solutions.
• Gather data from data sources to identify and interpret trends, optimize its efficiency and quality by analyzing and cleansing it, as well as resolving data quality issues.
• Run data queries to identify coding issues and data exceptions.
• Support clients in their journey towards becoming data-driven by bridging the gap between business and technology and advising them on best practices, tooling, implementation processes, ...
• Implement data quality principles, processes, and standards and embed them into the clients’ daily operating rhythm to improve trust in both business and technical data domains.
• Collaborate with business and database/application developers to improve processes, system- and database designs.
• 
Follow-up on the latest developments and trends in data quality analysis and tooling.

 

Your Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (engineering, IT, information management, etc.) or equivalent in experience.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in consulting or service-oriented environments, and at least 2 years of experience in data analysis.
• Experience with data quality tooling e.g., Collibra DQ, Soda, Great Expectations, Informatica CDQ, etc..
• Knowledge of data landscapes within an organization, understanding of end-to-end data flows (source to consumer), data architecture, and data engineering / -science principles.
• Affinity with use cases such as Business Glossary, Data Catalog, Data Lineage or Reporting Governance is a plus.
• Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment.
• Excellent leadership, communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.
 
Skillset
• Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proficiency in SQL supplemented with at least one other scripting language (e.g., Python, Groovy, R, etc.)
• Experience with Data Quality tooling.
• 
Experience with data governance solutions (Collibra, Datahub, Purview, etc.) is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Senior Digital Transformation Architect - Transportation sector
jobs.description:
Digital transformation is the cornerstone of Sopra Steria’s commitment to innovation and collaboration. It’s what brings businesses up to the present and secures them for the future. It’s how we align our tech and business goals to keep pace with emerging tech trends and best practices. To do so, you’ll need a forward-thinking, long-view, adaptable mindset to go with your problem solving and analytical skills. Proficiency in cloud computing, data analytics, cybersecurity, and AI skills all help us to collaborate in the business ecosystem to manage digital projects and make adoption of new tech simple and beneficial.

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problem-solving skills and commitment to continuous learning.

Small context :

From the start, you will be immersed in our company culture and way of working, understanding all the capabilities we use to serve our clients in their digital transformation journey. You will work closely with the Sopra Steria teams to provide strategic architectural guidance that helps our transportation clients navigate their transition challenges across the digital themes mentioned above.

Your role as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• You understand like no other the architectural landscape and digital challenges of our transportation customers. Moreover, you are capable and driven to help them design and implement transformative digital solutions while actively growing our advisory agency.
• You master core business processes in the transportation market and can seamlessly bridge the gap between business needs and technological solutions. You will:
• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for railway and public transportation operators
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as: Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives
• Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Transportation sector, with a focus on digital transformation.
• You will be encouraged and expected to bring innovative architectural thinking, challenge the status quo, and drive growth, both with our customers and within Sopra Steria.
 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• Higher degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 10+ years of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Transportation sector "REQUIRED".
• Proven track record in large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes (Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure).
• Fluent in French and English – Dutch is a plus
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in transportation.
• 
Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development

As a fullstack developer, you’ll play a key role in developing tailor-made applications for a diverse range of clients. Supported by a software architect and an experienced team of developers, you’ll be involved in every stage of the development cycle: design, development, implementation, and documentation.

The company stands out with a flat organizational structure, where your contributions are truly recognized. You’ll join a team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are central, with plenty of room for autonomy as well.

 

Responsibilities:

You are responsible for the entire application development process; together with your colleagues you build the perfect solution for the customer. 

To do so, you are assisted by a softwarearchitect with whom you determine the optimal architecture. From there, you take up your responsibility in the development cycle: from development and design to implementation and documentation. 

Thanks to our flat hierarchy your contribution to the result is always visible. You will join a team of other .Net developers in which knowledge sharing and teamwork are basic elements. 

However, independence is also required from time to time. The team is responsible for the complete implementation of projects: from the start-up and configuration to the final delivery.

Furthermore, they work on our newest E-trade products each day. Both products have an annual release program and road map in which you are an important link.

 

Your Profile : 

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science (or equivalent experience).
• Technical skills:
• Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET, and .NET Core.
• Knowledge of Entity Framework, microservices, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, or Xamarin is a plus.
• Languages: Proficiency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Flexibility: Willingness to travel occasionally for short trips abroad.
• 
Personality: You are customer-focused, eager to learn, open-minded, and a strong team player. A sense of humor is always a bonus!

As a qualification engineer you will work on projects in the life science industry. You will ensure that products, processes, systems, services, and documentation meet regional and global quality regulations and standards. Activities take place in a laboratory or production environment, or can relate to business technologies. Qualification engineers are active in various areas such as computer system validation (CSV), lab instrument qualification, method validation, cleaning validation, engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, project management, ... and so much more.

 

Profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation, life sciences and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

• You hold a master's or bachelor degree in a scientific direction (engineering, chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, biomedical sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, ...) or equivalent by experience.
• You are experienced in working in a regulated environment, with developed document writing skills and an eye for quality.
• You demonstrate the consultancy mindset by being pro-active, taking ownership and showing commitment.
• You have a problem-solving mindset and a strong sense of responsibility
• You want to learn and evolve
• You can work independently as well as in a team.
• 
You speak Dutch and English fluently

Responsibilities:

• Follow established software development methodologies and review processes
• Develop and execute end-to-end tests covering various scenarios, including edge cases and user experience
• Conduct thorough analyses of system sustainability and performance, generating detailed reports

Profile:

• Over 4 years of practical experience in Test-Driven Development, End-to-End Testing, and Integration Testing
• Solid technical foundation in JavaScript, Python, and XML programming languages
• Knowledge and practical experience with HTML5, CSS3, HTTP, REST, JSON, SQL, and Git
• Exceptional troubleshooting abilities and effective verbal communication skills
• A proactive approach to process improvement and innovative problem-solving
• A creative mindset, solution-oriented attitude, and a collaborative team spirit
• Strong planning and organizational skills
• Fluent in Dutch or French and English
• You are a highly motivated and enthusiastic learner, always seeking new knowledge and skills.
• You possess a critical thinking mindset, able to provide constructive feedback and identify areas for improvement.
• You strongly advocate for equality within the workplace, valuing each individual's contribution regardless of their job title.
• You are proactive and take initiative, often going the extra mile to assist your colleagues.
• You are open to receiving and providing feedback, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
• You are committed to personal development and self-awareness, actively seeking opportunities to grow and optimize your energy levels.

jobs.description:
As an Account Manager with experience within the Flemish public sector at Sopra Steria, you will play a crucial role in ensuring client retention by fostering and strengthening relationships. You’ll understand their individual needs, provide them tailored IT solutions and coordinate with internal teams to deliver the excellent service clients expect from Sopra Steria. Staying informed of industry trends, managing timelines, and answering client issues using confident communication and technical knowledge will be your day-to-day job as an Account Manager. You’re mindful of opportunities for upselling and cross-selling while building long term partnerships for community-wide digital transformation and business success.

Managing communication between the company and its clients is what our Sales colleagues do best. You’ll be an expert in how Sopra Steria delivers value. You’ll be cordial and deliver top-tier service to both internal and external clients. No one understands the needs and wants of our customers better, you’ll be able to anticipate and fulfil clients wishes with ease. Handling complex tasks without difficulty is crucial so you can hit deadlines and make sales to build a portfolio of satisfied accounts.

These engagements may involve working as part of high-performing teams embedded within client organizations or contributing to Sopra Steria’s fixed-price Consulting projects within multidisciplinary teams.

On specific projects, your responsibilities may include business and functional analysis, project management, architectural design and Agile/Scrum facilitation.
